items.t: Transmission failure or torque converter clutch fault
items.job: Replace automatic transmission (or torque converter and valve body)
items.note: A torque converter, valve body or bushing-kit repair costs much less than a full transmission. One owner report lists about $10,000 at a dealer.

items.t: 2.4L engine burns oil (warranty extension)
items.job: Oil consumption test; replace engine long block if it fails
items.note: Often covered by Fiat's extended warranty on the 2.4L for oil use. Ask a dealer with your VIN first.

items.t: 9-speed automatic shifts harshly, lags or shudders
items.job: Reprogram transmission computer and run quick-learn

items.t: Transmission may shift to neutral without warning (recall)
items.job: Reprogram engine and transmission computers; replace range sensor harness if needed

items.t: Radiator cooling fan fails and engine overheats (notice V54)
items.job: Replace engine cooling fan assembly under notice V54
items.note: Free under the notice if still open on your VIN.

items.t: Engine oil leaks from valve cover and seals
items.job: Find leak with dye; replace valve cover gasket or seal
items.note: Cost depends on where the leak is.

items.t: Start-stop or battery charging warnings
items.job: Test charging system; replace AGM battery or battery sensor

items.t: Dead battery and frequent jump starts
items.job: Battery drain test; replace 12-volt battery if weak

items.t: Turbo engine surges or sets underboost code P0299
items.job: Diagnose and update engine computer per bulletin

items.t: Airbag warning light on
items.job: Diagnose airbag system; repair connector or wiring

items.t: Seat belt buckle sensor may stop the front airbag (recall)
items.job: Repair seat belt buckle switch connection

items.t: Airbag computer software may disable safety systems (recall)
items.job: Update occupant restraint controller software

items.t: Engine computer chip can fail and stall the car (recall)
items.job: Replace powertrain control module

items.t: Rear brake caliper may be cracked (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace right rear brake caliper

items.t: Tire pressure warning may not light (recall)
items.job: Update instrument panel software

items.t: A/C stops blowing cold
items.job: Recharge A/C, or replace A/C compressor
items.note: A simple recharge costs far less than a compressor.

items.t: Check engine light for small EVAP leak (P0456)
items.job: Smoke test EVAP system; replace leaking part

items.t: Cranks but won't start in freezing weather (muffler TSB)
items.job: Drill a drain hole in the muffler (bulletin 09-004-20)

items.t: Misfire from ignition coil boots
items.job: Replace all four ignition coil boots (bulletin 08-027-20)

items.t: Uconnect, CarPlay or Bluetooth problems
items.job: Update radio software
items.note: Fiat tells dealers to rule out aftermarket cables before replacing parts.

items.t: False "low beam out" message
items.job: Reprogram body control module

items.t: Electronic parking brake won't set or key sticks
items.job: Update ABS module software

items.t: Front brakes squeal
items.job: Clean caliper brackets; replace front pads and hardware

items.t: Water on passenger floor from A/C drain tube
items.job: Secure A/C condensation drain tube

items.t: Check engine light from false fault codes
items.job: Diagnose codes; update engine computer

items.t: Transmission fluid leak at case seam or axle seal
items.job: Retorque case bolts or replace axle seal; top up fluid
